prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Meet Your New Desktop Companion", "Watch your pet roam, react, and play right on your desktop screen.", "Begin Setup"]
1: ["How to Control Your Desktop Pet", "Right-click your pet anytime to hide, summon, or open conversation mode.", "Got It, Let's Go!", "Tip: Press Alt+P to summon your pet instantly to your cursor."]
2: ["Save Your Adoption Certificate to Your Account", "Sign in now to lock in your newly named companion so you never lose your pet data.", "Using the same account on any PC will reload your pet instantly."]
3: ["Select Pet Personality Traits", "Choose how energetic, talkative, or calm your pet will be on your desktop.", "Save Personality", "Playful vs Chill"]
4: ["Official Pet Adoption Certificate", "Verify your pet's registry details before final spawn.", "Confirm & Finalize Adoption"]
5: ["Signing into your existing account restores all saved pets without losing progress."]
6: ["Building pet graphics, Registering desktop overlays, Spawning companion"]
7: ["Your Pet Has Arrived With a Welcome Gift!", "Your companion is active on your desktop. We added a free Starter Toy Set to your inventory!", "Unlocked: Free Starter Toy Pack"]
8: ["Choose How You Want to Adopt", "Pick a ready-to-play pet from our shelter library or generate a custom pet from your photos.", "Continue With Selected Path"]
9: ["We will send a quick system notification as soon as your pet appears on your desktop."]
